pages.text: 春天的下午，阳光暖暖的。咘咘牵着爸爸妈妈的手，一家人出门散步啦！NOMI背着小包走在旁边，NONO站在NOMI头上，迎着风张开翅膀。
pages.text_en: On a warm spring afternoon, Bubu held Daddy and Mommy's hands as the whole family went for a walk. NOMI carried a little bag beside them, and NONO perched on NOMI's head with wings spread in the breeze.

pages.text: 他们走过开满花的小路，蝴蝶在花丛里飞来飞去。咘咘蹦蹦跳跳地走着，裙子像一朵粉色的花。
pages.text_en: They walked along a path full of flowers, with butterflies dancing among the blossoms. Bubu bounced along happily, her dress swaying like a pink flower.

pages.text: 突然，咘咘停下了脚步。前面有一家冰淇淋店！彩色的招牌上画着好多种冰淇淋，咘咘的眼睛一下子亮了起来。「冰淇淋！冰淇淋！」咘咘拉着爸爸的手指着店门。
pages.text_en: Suddenly, Bubu stopped. There was an ice cream shop ahead! The colorful sign showed so many flavors. Bubu's eyes lit up instantly. She tugged Daddy's hand and pointed at the door.

pages.text: 爸爸笑着蹲下来，摸摸咘咘的头说：「想吃冰淇淋吗？爸爸给大家买一个超级大的！」咘咘开心地点点头，耳朵都竖起来了。
pages.text_en: Daddy smiled and knelt down, patting Bubu's head. 'Want some ice cream? Daddy will get a super big one for everyone!' Bubu nodded happily, her ears perking straight up.

pages.text: 爸爸走进店里，买了一个好大好大的冰淇淋！草莓味、巧克力味、香草味……堆得高高的，像一座彩色的小山。大家都张大了嘴巴。
pages.text_en: Daddy walked into the shop and came out with an enormous ice cream! Strawberry, chocolate, vanilla... scoops piled high like a colorful little mountain. Everyone's mouths dropped open.

pages.text: 妈妈拿出五个小碗，温柔地说：「来，妈妈给每个人分一份。」她用勺子把大冰淇淋一勺一勺分到小碗里，粉色的给咘咘，蓝色的给NOMI，红色的给NONO。
pages.text_en: Mommy took out five little bowls and said gently, 'Let me share it with everyone.' She scooped the ice cream into each bowl — pink for Bubu, blue for NOMI, and red for NONO.

pages.text: 咘咘捧着自己的小碗，小心翼翼地舀了一勺放进嘴里。「好好吃呀！」咘咘眯起眼睛，开心得小脚丫都在晃。
pages.text_en: Bubu held her little bowl carefully and took a tiny spoonful. 'So yummy!' She squinted with happiness, her little feet swinging back and forth.

pages.text: 爸爸大口大口地吃着巧克力味的，满脸幸福。妈妈优雅地品尝着香草味的，微笑着看大家。NOMI用小爪子捧着蓝色碗，一口一口吃得很认真。
pages.text_en: Daddy took big bites of chocolate flavor, looking blissful. Mommy elegantly savored her vanilla, smiling at everyone. NOMI held the blue bowl with her little paws, eating carefully bite by bite.

pages.text: NONO站在碗边上，把小脑袋探进红色小碗里，啄一口冰淇淋，抬头叫一声，再啄一口。大家看着NONO都笑了。
pages.text_en: NONO stood on the edge of the red bowl, dipping his little head in for a peck of ice cream, chirping, then pecking again. Everyone laughed watching NONO.

pages.text: 咘咘吃得太开心了，鼻子上沾了一大坨粉色的草莓冰淇淋！她还不知道呢，歪着头看大家为什么都在笑。爸爸妈妈笑得前仰后合，NOMI捂着嘴偷笑，NONO在空中转圈圈。
pages.text_en: Bubu was having so much fun eating that she got a big blob of pink strawberry ice cream on her nose! She didn't even know, tilting her head wondering why everyone was laughing. Daddy and Mommy laughed so hard, NOMI covered her mouth giggling, and NONO spun circles in the air.

pages.text: 妈妈用纸巾轻轻擦掉咘咘鼻子上的冰淇淋，亲了亲她的额头。咘咘终于知道大家在笑什么了，自己也咯咯咯地笑起来。
pages.text_en: Mommy gently wiped the ice cream off Bubu's nose with a tissue and kissed her forehead. Bubu finally realized what everyone was laughing about and giggled along too.

pages.text: 夕阳把天空染成了橙红色。一家人手牵着手，走在回家的路上。咘咘在中间，左手牵着爸爸，右手牵着妈妈。NOMI走在旁边，NONO飞在头顶。影子被拉得长长的，每个人心里都甜甜的。
pages.text_en: The sunset painted the sky orange and red. The family walked home hand in hand. Bubu was in the middle, holding Daddy's hand on the left and Mommy's on the right. NOMI walked alongside, and NONO flew overhead. Their shadows stretched long, and everyone's heart was filled with sweetness.
